newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury "no comment" on supposed budget leak.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury "no comment" on supposed budget leak.

text.p: The UK Treasury declined comment on Tuesday on supposed leaks of the content of the budget in two newspapers.
But a spokesman said he noted the story in the Sun newspaper was just speculation. "What the Sun has said is pure speculation," a spokesman said.
The Daily Mirror, a tabloid newspaper, said on Monday night that it had secret documents revealing tax changes but decided to return them to the government without publishing them.
The paper said Prime Minister John Major's office had confirmed the documents were genuine.
The Sun newspaper reported the budget would contain a one penny cut in income tax, but gave no source and did not say it had seen any official documents.
Late on Monday, a Treasury spokesman said the reported leaks would not change the content of the budget.
